findings.claim: A second apm install may not write okf-bundle back after patch deletes a stale one. Settled at project scope by spike:plugin-patch/1.
Consumers on the ADR 0013 string entry or the v0.3.0 layout had no path once install goes. The plan now has patch refuse and name the apm uninstall, the new entry and apm install.

At --scope user, the claude cleanup deletes an okf-bundle kmctl wrote to the user MCP file (claude mcp add-json, ~/.claude.json) and tells the user to run apm install again. spike:plugin-patch/1 only showed APM writing it back at project scope (.mcp.json, .agents/mcp_config.json); nothing shows apm install -g writes a dependencies.mcp server to Claude Code's user MCP config at all (apm-only-install/2 covered skills, agents and rules only). If it does not, a user-scope consumer loses okf's server and the advice cannot bring it back.
